title: Battlepack section 13 - equipment and attribute tables, as documented by the Vanilla Section 13 / Vanilla Attribute Offsets / Description Calculator sheets

container.notes: Section 13 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill). The section itself is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by packed entries and zero padding to 16 bytes. Header slot 0x18 = attribute-table offset; a second table of 24-byte attribute records runs from there to the end of the section.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of equipment records (the Toolkit lists name 557 rows, 0 Unarmed … 556).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 52 (0x34) for this section.

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted; keep.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: attributeTableOffset: offset of the attribute table from the section start. The Workshop always places it right after the equipment records (= 32 + entryCount*52).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: equipment
records.where: st2e entries of section 13: header.entryListOffset + i*52; row i = gear id i (S13 Vanilla Section 13!r(i+2), 557 rows 0-556)

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not interpreted (the Workshop skips it and writes 0).

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Name text id (equipment block, 2048+). Sheet S13 column B "Gear" (shows <id+4096>:<name>, not the stored text id).

fields.name: icon
fields.notes: Menu icon. Sheet S13 column D "Icon" (<id>:<name>).

fields.name: unknown05
fields.notes: Not interpreted.

fields.name: optimizationTiebreaker
fields.notes: Tie-break rank used when the Optimize command compares equal items. Sheet S13 column E "Optimization".

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Bits 0 and 3 are unnamed; the Workshop rebuilds the byte from the named bits only. Sheet S13 column F "Flags Array" (whole byte, decimal).

fields.name: sort
fields.notes: Menu sort key. Sheet S13 column G "Sort".

fields.name: category
fields.notes: Equipment category; selects the variant layout of bytes 0x11 and 0x18-0x33: 0-17 weapon, 18 shield, 19-22 helm/armor/accessory/crown ("armor" variant), 23+ ammunition. Sheet S13 column L "Category" (name only).

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted.

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Description text id; labelled ineffectual (unused by the game) by the Workshop and the Toolkit.

fields.name: metal
fields.notes: Metal property byte (meaning not documented beyond the name). Sheet S13 column H "Metal".

fields.name: offhandCategory
fields.notes: only: weapon — category of the off-hand item (ammo/shield) this weapon pairs with; for other variants this byte is not interpreted. Sheet S13 column J "Offhand Category" (<id>:<name>).

fields.name: gil
fields.notes: Buy price (all variants). Unsigned; 65535 acts as a "none" sentinel in places (msg 534-537, 620). Sheet S13 column I "Gil".

fields.name: unknown14
fields.notes: Not interpreted (all variants; ammunition also leaves 0x18-0x19 uninterpreted).

fields.name: range
fields.notes: only: weapon — attack range. Sheet S13 column M "Range".

fields.name: shieldEvade
fields.notes: only: shield — physical evade. Sheet S13 column R "Evade" (shields).

fields.name: defense
fields.notes: only: armor — defense. Sheet S13 column AE "Defense".

fields.name: formula
fields.notes: only: weapon — attack formula (same id space as action formulas; swapping it has side effects, msg 493-503). Sheet S13 column N "Formula".

fields.name: shieldMagickEvade
fields.notes: only: shield — magick evade. Sheet S13 column S "MEvade".

fields.name: magickResist
fields.notes: only: armor — magick resist. Sheet S13 column AF "Resist".

fields.name: attackPower
fields.notes: only: weapon, ammunition — attack power. Sheet S13 column O "Attack".

fields.name: augment
fields.notes: only: armor — augment granted while equipped (section 58 row). Sheet S13 column AG "Augment" (255 = none).

fields.name: knockbackChance
fields.notes: only: weapon — knockback chance. Sheet S13 column P "Knockback".

fields.name: comboOrCriticalChance
fields.notes: only: weapon — combo (or critical, depending on weapon type) chance. Sheet S13 column Q "Combo/Crit".

fields.name: evade
fields.notes: only: weapon, ammunition — evade bonus. Sheet S13 column R "Evade".

fields.name: elements
fields.notes: only: weapon, ammunition — attack element(s). Sheet S13 column T "Element".

fields.name: onHitRate
fields.notes: only: weapon, ammunition — chance to inflict statusEffects. Sheet S13 column U "On-hit %".

fields.name: statusEffects
fields.notes: only: weapon, ammunition — statuses inflicted on hit. Sheet S13 column V-Y "Inflict Status1-4" (one byte each).

fields.name: unknown24
fields.notes: Not interpreted (any variant). Sheet S13 column Z "Unused" (non-zero for many weapons: 3 sword/bow, 5 spear/staff/measure, 7 greatsword, 8 crossbow, 10 pole/hammer).

fields.name: distanceBehavior
fields.notes: only: weapon — approach behaviour, e.g. whether the attacker steps back before striking (msg 532). Sheet S13 column AA "Distance Behavior" (name only).

fields.name: stance
fields.notes: only: weapon — weapon stance (section 0 row). Sheet S13 column AB "Stance" (name only).

fields.name: chargeTime
fields.notes: only: weapon — charge time of a normal attack. Sheet S13 column AC "CT".

fields.name: attributeLink
fields.notes: All variants: byte offset of this item's attribute record, counted from the start of the attribute table (header.offset18). attributeIndex = attributeLink / 24; must be a multiple of 24. Several items may share one record. Sheet S13 column AH "Attrib ID" = attributeLink / 24.

fields.name: particleEffect
fields.notes: only: weapon — swing/trail particle effect.

fields.name: unknown2E
fields.notes: Not interpreted (any variant).

fields.name: model
fields.notes: only: weapon, shield, ammunition — model id (prefix letter << 16 | number; weapons use prefix w). For the armor variant bytes 0x2C-0x33 are not interpreted. Sheet S13 column AD "Model ID" (decimal).

records.name: attribute
records.where: Attribute table of section 13: header.offset18 + k*24, running to the end of the section
records.count: floor((sectionLength - header.offset18) / 24), sectionLength = span of section 13 in the battlepack (trailing pad < 24 bytes is ignored)

fields.name: maxHp
fields.notes: Max HP bonus. Sheet S13 column AI "HP".

fields.name: maxMp
fields.notes: Max MP bonus. Sheet S13 column AJ "MP".

fields.name: strength
fields.notes: Strength bonus. Sheet S13 column AK "Strength".

fields.name: magickPower
fields.notes: Magick Power bonus. Sheet S13 column AL "Magick".

fields.name: vitality
fields.notes: Vitality bonus. Sheet S13 column AM "Vitality".

fields.name: speed
fields.notes: Speed bonus. Sheet S13 column AN "Speed".

fields.name: statusEffects
fields.notes: Statuses granted while equipped (auto-status). Sheet S13 column AO "Equip Status".

fields.name: statusEffectImmunities
fields.notes: Status immunities granted. Sheet S13 column AP "Immune Status".

fields.name: elementAbsorb
fields.notes: Elements absorbed. Sheet S13 column AQ "Absorb Ele".

fields.name: elementImmune
fields.notes: Elements nullified. Sheet S13 column AR "Immune Ele".

fields.name: elementHalfDamage
fields.notes: Elements halved. Sheet S13 column AS "Half Ele".

fields.name: elementWeak
fields.notes: Elemental weaknesses. Sheet S13 column AT "Weak Ele".

fields.name: elementPotency
fields.notes: Elements whose damage is boosted. Sheet S13 column AU "Potency".

fields.name: unused15
fields.notes: Padding; the Workshop writes three zero bytes.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/unused*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
Never zero bytes that are "not interpreted" for the record's variant; vanilla data in those bytes must survive.
Keep attributeLink a multiple of 24 and < attributeCount*24.
When equipment rows are added, move the attribute table and update header.offset18; attributeLink values stay.
Do not write 255 into weapon gil fields by accident: msg 665-675 report a tool that corrupted every weapon price that way.
flags (0x07): change only bits 1, 2, 4-7; preserve bits 0 and 3.
Sheet values are decimal; Model ID is the s32 model field as one number (e.g. 7799017 = 0x0077_00E9).
Attrib ID in the sheet is the attribute index; the file stores index*24 (attributeLink). Use enum AttributeLinkOffset on the stored field.
gaps: Bytes 0x00-0x01, 0x05, 0x0A-0x0D, 0x14-0x17, 0x24, 0x2E-0x2F and every variant block byte not listed for a variant are never interpreted.
flags bits 0 and 3 are unnamed; the Workshop drops them on write.
Meaning of metal (0x10) beyond its name; optimizationTiebreaker semantics are inferred from the name.
Whether vanilla files always place the attribute table directly after the equipment records (the Workshop assumes so on write but reads header.offset18).
Whether attribute records may be shared intentionally by the game for anything beyond saving space.
Message 850-865: a third-party editor did not save ammunition edits; that was a tool bug, not a format issue.
The S13 sheet has no raw bytes; columns were matched to fields by name and order only (unlike the S14/S57 sheets, which carry the record hex).
Byte 0x24 ("Unused" in the sheet, unknown24 in battlepack-s13) is non-zero for 109 weapons with a value that follows weapon type; its meaning is unknown.

The sheet's B column prefix (4096+id) and the Description Calculator keys ({4096+id, "..."}) are a text id for equipment help text, but which text table they index is not stated (the stored name field uses 2048+).
Attribute sets 0-175 come from AO (176 rows); whether vanilla has more attribute records than that is not shown.
